verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that datasets are versioned collections of test cases that can be built from production logs, user feedback, manual curation, or Loop generation. Experiments run offline evals against them from code or the UI, with CI/CD integration, and the SDK's `Eval()` API confirms the code-driven eval flow. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the trace-to-dataset curation workflow (e.g., selecting or filtering spans into a dataset), and independent or hands-on corroboration of this end-to-end flow.
